# Time budgets for go test, read by testtime (majorcontext/tools).
# CI enforces them in its reference environment. The land check runs the tests for pass or fail only.
#   leaf SECONDS                  a test that has no subtests
#   package PATH|default SECONDS  wall time of one package, run alone (go test -p 1); PATH@JOB sets it for one job
#   test PATH NAME SECONDS        tests of PATH whose name starts with NAME
# A test with subtests is not checked, because a parallel parent reports the time of the whole package.
# A change that makes a test or package slower raises its number in the same diff and states why.

# testtime multiplies every time limit by max(1, measured / calibrate). calibrate is the calibration time of the CI reference runner.
calibrate 0.055
# The check of the seams table runs git twice: it reads the gap file at the merge base.
count internal/seamcheck processes 2
leaf 10
package default 10
# cmd/ward holds the end-to-end tests of the land train, the mirror and the seed. They run a real motte test server and
# git, about 460 git processes and 40 s of CPU on the reference runner, which keeps the package at 11 s with full
# parallelism. The test-side costs are already cut; the rest is the git work of the mirror and the seed in the product.
package cmd/ward 14
# The container and gvisor suites start a container for each case and pull the test image once. A run of the two takes a few seconds with a warm image.
package internal/runner/sandbox/container 40
package internal/runner/sandbox/gvisor 40
